label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is '/data/' + param where param comes directly from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest'). While there is a pattern check (param.matches(pat)), this only validates the parameter against a deploy-time pattern, not preventing path traversal attacks. An attacker could supply '../etc/passwd' or similar traversal sequences that might pass the pattern check depending on what 'file.pattern' contains. The sink expression Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get('/data/' + param)) receives attacker-controlled input without proper path sanitization. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input param from request.getParameter flows directly into Paths.get('/data/' + param)
Sink: Files.readAllBytes called with unsanitized user-controlled path component
